messages:
ravi: Quick sync: opened PR #3582 to add a tiny OptKit migration snippet that demonstrates batching + kv_prefetch for short inputs. failing linkcheck and one lint error in the python snippet. can someone patch?

anna: I can take lint. probably an extra trailing comma in the dict. also the python example uses `prefetch=True` which is old param name. should be `kv_prefetch=True`.

ravi: thanks. the broken link is to the console deep link; docs moved the page. i'll update to /optimize/kv-and-batching.

build-bot: lint error: examples/optkit/python_snippet.py:12 trailing comma. linkcheck: /optimize/kv-and-batching -> 404

taylor: heads up — staging moved the optimize slug. correct path is /optimize/batching-and-kv. i'll push a tiny commit with the corrected path and the param rename. also add a one-line note about "q4 variants + short seqs may show higher p50 until cache warms; consider a short warmup or increase batch_size."

anna: pushed fixes. ran local mkdocs linkcheck; passes now.

build-bot: CI passed (lint, linkcheck). staging deploy started (build 7892).

ravi: great. can we add a small JS snippet showing `max_inflight` limit? users keep copying code that fires unlimited concurrent requests.

taylor: added a 3-line JS example with `client.settings.max_inflight = 4;` and a comment about tradeoffs.

ravi: perfect. merging in 5. will backport the stanza to v1.9 docs.

build-bot: PR #3582 merged by ravi — docs/staging deployed to https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/optimize (build 7892).

ravi: added one-line changelog: "Doc: OptKit migration snippet — clarify kv_prefetch and batching defaults, add concurrency note." closing thread. :white_check_mark:
